An elderly scarred [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''[[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Felucian]]''' [[Felucian shaman|shaman]] served as the chief of the [[Felucian Sanctuary]]. Soon after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he assisted a group of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] agents in their quest to raid the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] prison facility called the [[Vanishing Place]] and liberate [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilder Varth]].
